headline: Comfort Systems USA Announces Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call and Webcast
summary: HOUSTON, October 16, 2026--Comfort Systems USA, Inc. (NYSE: FIX), a leading provider of mechanical and electrical contracting services including heating, ventilation, air conditioning, plumbing, electrical, piping and controls, announces that it has scheduled its quarterly conference call and webcast for Friday, October 23, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Central Time to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results. The results will be released after the market closes on Thursday, October 22, 2026.
